note: Whether each provider would serve an identified crawler. Three things are read, not one: its robots.txt, the ANSWER its front page gives — a 200 carrying «Verifying your browser» or «Přístup zablokován» is a refusal — and, where a firewall is what refused, whether the institution publishes somewhere else. A provider that NAMES this crawler is not probed for a side entrance; being told no by name is the end of it.
